name: Edara Connect
author: EDRAK Software

sections.description:
Edara Connect integrates your WooCommerce store with Edara ERP, a powerful cloud-based solution for managing finances, sales, inventory, and operations. Whether you run an e-commerce business, retail store, or distribution network, this plugin streamlines your workflows by connecting all business operations into a single platform.

Features

  1. Seamless Order Sync from WooCommerce to edara for streamlined processing.
  2. Effortless Customer Sync from WooCommerce to edara for unified data management.
  3. Automatic Inventory Balance Sync ensures accurate product quantities across platforms.
  4. Real-time Price and Product Data Updates for consistent information.

Privacy & Data Collection

Support & Debugging Data Collection

To provide optimal support and resolve technical issues efficiently, Edara Connect automatically collects anonymous error logs and diagnostic information. This data helps our support team identify and fix integration issues quickly.

What We Collect:
* Error messages and API response details (when errors occur)
* Website URL and basic technical information (PHP version, WordPress version, plugin version)
* Request context and timestamps for debugging purposes
* No personal customer data, order contents, or sensitive business information is collected

How It’s Used:
* Exclusively for technical support and debugging purposes
* Helps identify and resolve integration issues faster
* Enables proactive improvements to plugin stability
* Data is automatically anonymized and securely handled

Your Control:
* Only error/diagnostic data is collected – no personal or business data
* Data collection is essential for providing reliable technical support
* All data follows WordPress and privacy best practices

By using Edara Connect, you acknowledge this data collection for support purposes. If you have privacy concerns, please contact our support team.
sections.changelog:
2025-09-29 – version 2.0.1

  • Implemented smart error message extraction from Edara API responses.
  • Eliminated duplicate logging across all plugin components for cleaner error tracking.
  • Added detailed error context and operation-specific logging for better debugging.
  • Improved error handling in all API communications and data synchronization processes.

2025-09-15 – version 2.0.0

  • Handled discount updates from WooCommerce to Edara.
  • Added sales person selection to be sent with the order.
  • Added support to link payment methods in WooCommerce to GL accounts in Edara.
  • Enhanced error logging and debugging system for improved support.
  • Implemented comprehensive error tracking with Google Sheets integration for faster issue resolution.

2025-09-01 – version 1.2.4

  • Added a safeguard to prevent repeated updates between Edara and WooCommerce.

2025-08-31 – version 1.2.3

  • Add more order cleanups to match discounts between woocommerce and edara.

2025-08-31 – version 1.2.2

  • Dynamic properties are now mapped with woocommerce global attributes.
  • Fix orders discounts being double applied on updates from edara.

2025-08-21 – version 1.2.1

  • Fix wrong customer issue

2025-07-06 – version 1.2.0

  • Added incoming order updates from Edara to WooCommerce
  • Added WooCommerce Order Number to paper number in Edara
  • Added option to choose either Edara price or dealer price for WooCommerce regular price with discounts

2025-06-19 – version 1.1.1

  • Added WooCommerce order cancellation sync with Edara ERP.

2025-06-16 – version 1.1.0

  • Added advanced product sync direction and robust product linking
  • Improved variable product and WPML compatibility (main product only for price/stock)
  • Enhanced settings UI/UX and product table display
  • Fixed duplicate product linking and empty SKU handling
  • General bug fixes and performance improvements

2025-06-12 – version 1.0.4

  • Improved performance by optimizing cache handling
  • Fixed API token persistence issues
  • Enhanced API communication reliability

2025-05-07 – version 1.0.3

  • Bug fixes

2025-03-04 – version 1.0.2

  • Bug fixes & base improvements

2025-03-04 – version 1.0.1

  • Bug fixes

2025-01-27 – version 1.0.0

  • First public release
